$comment: One message: code is the language every builder shares. Art: a globe that is also a speech bubble, code running round it like latitudes (products/xooteq/art.mjs -> code-globe). Motion: the code turns like the world, one mover, 3 s move + 1 s hold.
headline: Code is the international language.
subhead: Your code reads the same in every country. Build what matters, with people who speak it.
